info.name: LJVIS — ERRU XML Adapter
info.description: Exercises docker/erru-xml-adapter directly (not through Ruuter): durable acceptance of raw ERRU 3.5 XML, the three replay outcomes (fresh / exact redelivery / conflicting redelivery), XSD rejection, and the full NotifyUnfitness_Request -> Ruuter.internal -> NotifyUnfitness_Acknowledgement -> mock Hub pipeline. See docker/erru-xml-adapter/README.md for which message types are processed.

item.name: [Setup] generate technicalId/workflowId for this run
Adapter and Hub mock are healthy
Hub mock reachable, capture baseline delivery count
Malformed XML is rejected, nothing stored

body.raw: this is not XML at all

item.name: Unsupported root element is rejected, nothing stored
Oversized body is rejected with 413, not an OOM risk
DOCTYPE is rejected with 400, not 500

body.raw:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE NotifyUnfitness_Request [<!ENTITY x "pwned">]>
<NotifyUnfitness_Request xmlns="https://webgate.ec.testa.eu/move-hub/erru/3.5">
  <Header version="3.5" technicalId="{{$guid}}" workflowId="{{$guid}}" sentAt="2026-09-23T09:15:00Z" from="DE" to="EE"/>
  <Body businessCaseId="DE-NU-DOCTYPE&x;" originatingAuthority="DE-BAG" requestSource="CA" requestPurpose="Control">
    <TransportManager unfitStartDate="2026-09-23">
      <TransportManagerNameDetails>
        <TransportManager firstName="HANS" familyName="MUELLER" dateOfBirth="1975-04-12"/>
        <CertificateOfProfessionalCompetence certificateNumber="DE-CPC-000123" certificateIssueDate="2010-05-01" certificateIssueCountry="DE"/>
      </TransportManagerNameDetails>
    </TransportManager>
  </Body>
</NotifyUnfitness_Request>

exec: pm.test('rejected at the DTD peek, not just the defence-in-depth re-parse', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.include('DOCTYPE'));

item.name: Delivered ACK is well-formed and correlates to the original request

exec: pm.test('workflowId correlates to the original request', () => pm.expect(xml).to.include('workflowId="' + pm.collectionVariables.get('nu_workflow_id') + '"'));

pm.test('ack technicalId is NOT the inbound technicalId (fresh outbound id, no correlation-id reuse)', () => pm.expect(xml).to.not.include('technicalId="' + pm.collectionVariables.get('nu_technical_id') + '"'));

item.name: [Wait] then check the CGR answer actually says Found (not a fabricated/mistranslated field)
CGR Found answer has the real MTR data, not NotAvailable or a placeholder

exec: pm.test('CGR MemberState statusCode is Found, not NotAvailable', () => pm.expect(body).to.include('statusCode="Found"'));
pm.test('licence status is the real value, not a fabricated default', () => pm.expect(body).to.include('communityLicenceStatus="Active"'));
pm.test('licence number is the real value, not "unknown"', () => pm.expect(body).to.include('communityLicenceNumber="EE-CL-2020-11111"'));
pm.test('numberOfVehicles is a clean integer, not "8.0"', () => pm.expect(body).to.include('numberOfVehicles="8"'));
pm.test('address is the real value, not "unknown"/"00000"', () => pm.expect(body).to.include('address="Tartu mnt 12"'));

item.name: [Wait] then check the CTUD answer actually says Found
CTUD Found answer translates the compact licence-type code to the real XSD string

exec: pm.test('CTUD statusCode is Found, not NotAvailable (regression: this used to always fail here)', () => pm.expect(body).to.include('statusCode="Found"'));
pm.test('communityLicenceType is the real XSD long-form string, not the compact classifier code', () => pm.expect(body).to.include('communityLicenceType="Community licence for goods transport"'));
pm.test('communityLicenceType is NOT the raw compact code', () => pm.expect(body).to.not.include('CommunityLicenceGoods'));
pm.test('respondingAuthority is the flow\'s own EE-TRAM, not NU\'s EE-PPA', () => pm.expect(body).to.include('respondingAuthority="EE-TRAM"'));
pm.test('numberOfEmployees is a clean integer, not "63.0"', () => pm.expect(body).to.include('numberOfEmployees="63"'));
